subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should the Teams Graph media fallback be broadened by default for channel/group HTML stubs, or gated behind an explicit `channels.msteams.graphMediaFallback` setting?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the open PRs embody different fallback policies with different compatibility and Graph-load tradeoffs, so automation should not choose the operator-facing default.

options.title: Config-gated fallback
options.body: Prefer the default-off `graphMediaFallback` path so existing mention-only traffic keeps current behavior and operators opt into the extra Graph lookup when they need group/channel attachment recovery.

options.title: Always broaden channel fallback
options.body: Accept the broader fallback from the older channel PR and rely on tests/logging to manage the extra Graph reads and mention-only diagnostics risk.

options.title: Consolidate both PRs first
options.body: Ask the PR authors to combine team GUID/reply URL fixes with the config-gated fallback so one canonical PR owns the full channel and group-chat attachment behavior.

recommendation.title: Config-gated fallback
recommendation.body: Prefer the default-off `graphMediaFallback` path so existing mention-only traffic keeps current behavior and operators opt into the extra Graph lookup when they need group/channel attachment recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest evidence and open PR focus exactly on the fallback policy tradeoff that now needs maintainer selection.
